content: {"summary":"Edge gateways returned 429 responses with the EDGE‑RL01 code because a March 2026 marketing campaign sent search traffic that exceeded the per‑pod rate‑limit configured in the edge‑gateway Envoy pods.","likely_cause":"The spring marketing email campaign generated a traffic spike (~420 req/s) that surpassed the existing 100 tokens‑per‑second per‑pod limit (300 total), triggering the edge‑gateway rate limiter to return 429 EDGE‑RL01 errors.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Edge gateway uses a per‑pod local rate limiter that returns 429 with code EDGE‑RL01","evidence_ids":["RB-030#0"],"quote":"On the `/search` route, and only that route, each pod runs a local rate limiter"},{"text":"Rate limit was 100 tokens per second per pod (300 total) and had not been updated for increased traffic","evidence_ids":["RB-030#1"],"quote":"In March it was 100 tokens a second on each of the three"},{"text":"Marketing campaign peaked at ~420 req/s, exceeding the 300 allowed and causing 429s","evidence_ids":["RB-030#1","RB-030#2"],"quote":"the first `429`s showed up at 09:05, and by 09:10 `/search` had peaked at about 420 requests a second"},{"text":"All 429 responses carried the EDGE‑RL01 error code, indicating they originated from the edge limiter","evidence_ids":["RB-030#2"],"quote":"a wall of `429`s, every body carrying `EDGE-RL01`"},{"text":"Raising the limit to 250 req/s per pod (750 total) stopped the 429s, confirming the limit was the trigger","evidence_ids":["RB-030#3"],"quote":"the `429`s stopped at 09:50 ... 750 for the edge, about 1.8 times the campaign's peak"}],"next_checks":["Verify the current edge‑gateway‑envoy ConfigMap limit settings and ownership","Monitor per‑pod rate‑limit counters during traffic spikes","Assess traffic distribution across the three edge pods","Confirm that the limit is reviewed and adjusted for future growth"]}
